Dear Dana Whitfield,

**Situation Summary**

Tamarack Instruments designs and manufactures laboratory measurement instruments and operates in the Netherlands, Germany and the United States. A customer service chatbot is deployed on the support portal. AI visual inspection is being piloted on the German production line, and AI sales forecasting is planned for next year. Your stated objective is: "I want governance in place before visual inspection goes into production in Q2 2027." An internal audit finding from June 2026 recorded that there is no inventory of AI systems. ISO/IEC 42001 work is expected to start next year, although the start date is not fixed.

**What the Briefing Covers for the Client**

The session maps the EU AI Act and GDPR to your use cases. These are expectations to verify with counsel, not legal advice. For the chatbot, we will cover transparency. For visual inspection, we will address the risk classification question. For data protection, we will include the constraint that customer data stays in the EU. United States developments appear only as a general landscape item, as no US regulatory driver is stated.

The readiness discussion starts from the missing AI inventory. It also considers how AI governance could align with ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO 9001, which are noted as incumbent frameworks. The operating model draws on the GRC Workbook (https://github.com/rolldabones/grc-workbook) and the Slow AI Kitchen (https://github.com/rolldabones/slow-ai-kitchen). Board-level framing comes from AI Governance for Boards (https://github.com/rolldabones/ai-governance-for-boards). Sequencing will respect the requirement that the German works council is consulted before anything touches production staff. Throughout, we apply three principles: Slow AI, Informed Intent, Final Liability rests with the Human.

**Logistics and Price**

The Executive Briefing is a two-hour live virtual session for executive leadership and board-level attendees. It is priced at US$3,000, which is within the stated budget of up to US$80,000 this fiscal year. It is designed for the listed roles: General Counsel, CISO, Head of Quality, Head of Data, German plant manager and two internal auditors.

**What the Client Receives Afterward**

You receive a written follow-up memo covering decisions surfaced, readiness observations and three prioritized recommendations. Each recommendation is mapped to a possible next program option. We do not promise certification, audit outcomes or regulatory approval, including for ISO/IEC 42001.

**Next Step**

A decision is expected by 15 December 2026. We propose a short call to confirm a session date and attendees.

Kind regards,

Senior AI Governance Consultant
AI Governance Academy

Human-made, for Easy Work, Simply Done.
